Triage Rationale and Technical Scope

Static print PDF documents have no continuous JavaScript runtime loop, no interactive mouse pointer, no scroll viewport, and no audio speaker device. The following categories are formally classified as unsupported print non-goals or browser-only features:

Animation & Timelines
45 Props
Static print captures t=0
Interactive Scroll
41 Props
Paginated sheets
Pointer & UI Chrome
25 Props
No mouse / caret
Speech & Aural
19 Props
Visual PDF stream
